data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's causal test is unsound as a discriminator. The mechanism asserts: uniform response across different environments => correlated shared cause; divergent response => truly independent. But a shared latent cause hitting heterogeneous environments can produce divergent responses (shared cause, different failure signatures), and independent failures sharing a common environmental trigger can produce uniform responses. The Trigger-Response Divergence criterion conflates response heterogeneity with failure-independence and therefore cannot reliably distinguish truly independent failure modes from merely apparently uncorrelated ones.
